description:
Wire up DRF TokenAuthentication so the payload ingest endpoint (HDT-7) can require a token. PROMPT.md: 'There should be basic Token authentication in this payload.'

Scope: add 'rest_framework.authtoken' to INSTALLED_APPS, add a REST_FRAMEWORK settings dict with DEFAULT_AUTHENTICATION_CLASSES = TokenAuthentication and DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES = IsAuthenticated (secure by default — the ingest view then needs no per-view auth config), run the authtoken migration, and document token creation in README.md (manage.py drf_create_token <username>, requests send 'Authorization: Token <key>').

Decision context: use DRF's built-in TokenAuthentication rather than JWT or a custom header — PROMPT.md says 'basic Token authentication' and built-in is the least surprising choice for a reviewer setting this up locally. Defaulting the whole API to IsAuthenticated is deliberate: it means a future view cannot accidentally ship unauthenticated.

Out of scope: the endpoint itself (HDT-7), user/device provisioning UI, token rotation, per-device tokens.

Note: HDT-5 deliberately left authtoken and the REST_FRAMEWORK dict out of settings so this task owns them.
title: Configure DRF token authentication
